purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity PR More Details details.
features: PR More Details Function allows the user to view and process the Port Releases belonging to the selected PR group.
The user should select one or more records before clicking Process.
On processing, a result popup shows the success or error message for each record.

events.description: Opens the PR More Details screen in a new tab listing the releases of the selected PR group
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks PR More Details [TR] from the single function menu

events.description: Processes the selected records and shows the PR More Details result popup with Code, Description and Solution for each record
events.triggered_when: User selects records and clicks Process
events.remarks: At least one record should be selected.

events.triggered_when: User clicks × on the PR More Details popup
